_comment: Class-B constants for the Planner Calculator. No game table states any of these, so they are declared once here and copied into data/gacha_rules.json. portraitCopies: how many copies of a 6★ unlock P5 (P0 = the first copy, then one duplicate per portrait). dropsPerUnilog: the shop price of one pull (180 Crystal Drops). rateUpShare: the default 50/50 between the rate-up 6★ and the standard pool. track: which pity counter a banner spends and banks, and the only thing the tab asks the reader to fill in — `rateUp` is shared by Debut and Rerun, `ripples` belongs to Ripples on the Water alone, and `solo` means the banner keeps its own counter that nothing else can see (Limited, Event, Collab and Yearning), so a fresh one always starts at zero. freePulls: pulls the banner hands out at its patch start before the reader spends anything. discountFirst10: Unilogs knocked off the first ten-pull. selectFirstSix: the first 6★ is a character selector, so it can never miss. patchFirstLimited: the exchange every Limited patch opens with — its headline Limited banner hands one portrait token per {pulls}, and the token buys a copy of the rate-up, so portraits are cheaper to hunt there than on any other Limited banner.

patchFirstLimited._comment: The first Limited banner of a Limited patch (the one no other Limited run opened within a patch before) trades one bonus copy of its rate-up for every 200 pulls of the run. The trade repeats: 560 pulls buys two. That is how Huntsworn Lilya's banner is easier to take to P5.

byBanner._comment: Keyed by the spreadsheet's banner name, merged *on top of* the type rule above. The notes below quote its own 'Pity Explained' text, which is the only place these rules are written down.
